thread_pair_example: block 3 thread 200 does its atomicAdd of its bins after thread 0 of block 3 has already executed atomicInc(finished_block_cnt) (finalize_pass L652-L660: __threadfence per thread, then thread 0's atomicInc with no __syncthreads); the last block then reads the same bin (volatile load) and zeroes it (plain store).
class_reason: atomic vs volatile load: both strong, unordered -> strong conflict (SC, D20); atomic vs plain store: not both strong -> data race (DR).
buggy_expected: SC for {merge_histograms atomicAdd, compute_bin_offsets volatile load} plus DR for {merge_histograms atomicAdd, init_histograms plain store}, in cross-block form on the global histogram.

fixed.reason: uncertain (verify.expected_report_fixed). The fix puts __syncthreads() (agent_topk.cuh:654 at 879ab26) between the per-thread __threadfence (:651) and thread 0's atomicInc (:660), so in every block each merge_histograms atomicAdd is followed by that thread's fence and, through the barrier, precedes the block's retirement increment. The last block still has no fence after its own atomicInc: atomicInc (:660) -> __syncthreads_or (:665) -> volatile histogram loads (compute_bin_offsets, called at :673) -> ... -> init_histograms zeroing stores (called at :683). Under a strict PTX reading there is no acquire pattern on the reading side, so BOTH buggy pairs survive: atomicAdd vs volatile load (SC) and atomicAdd vs the plain zeroing store (DR), i.e. a residual DR+SC report on the same three sites, not an SC report alone. A detector that treats __threadfence + atomic counter as a release/acquire hand-off reports nothing. Builder's SASS note: ATOMG.E.INC.STRONG.GPU, then BAR.RED.OR, then the volatile loads, no MEMBAR in between. T21b triages a fixed-build report here against this note; it is not a false positive by default.

review.notes: Checked at 8b99dbe: finalize_pass (agent_topk.cuh:642-684) has the per-thread __threadfence (:652) and thread 0's atomicInc (:656-660) with no barrier in between, while other threads of the block may not yet have issued their merge_histograms atomicAdd (:441/:448; merge_histograms is called at :580 and :826, immediately before finalize_pass at :792/:828). The last block is another block (inside the retiring block __syncthreads_or at :663 orders the late thread); it reads the global histogram through volatile OffsetT* (:584, :589 -> block_load.cuh:379 LoadDirectStriped) and then zeroes it (:681 -> :422/:427). Pass 0 runs DeviceTopKHistogramKernel (invoke_histogram_only) and passes 1.. run DeviceTopKKernel (invoke_filter_and_histogram), one launch per pass (cub/cub/device/dispatch/dispatch_topk.cuh:616-693), so the race is within one launch, cross-block, and both kernels contain it. is_last_pass is a runtime bool, so init_histograms at :681 is compiled into both kernels (the open_questions note puts the STG only in DeviceTopKKernel; by source it is in both). Classes: atomic (strong) vs volatile load (strong) = unordered strong conflict SC; atomic vs plain store = DR; DR+SC as pre-registered. Counting the SC pair depends on D20 (option (ii) counts only the DR pair). sass_notes are the builder's: the reviewer read sources and diffs only and did not re-dump SASS (the one srun queued with an estimated start the next day and was withdrawn).
